inbound.subject: Request for 10% discount on INV-2026-0142
inbound.body_text:
Dear Team,

Given the delayed delivery on our last order we request a 10% discount on invoice INV-2026-0142 before we release payment.

Regards,
Suresh Rao

recorded_reply.body_text:
Dear Mr. Rao,

Thank you for your email. We are happy to offer the 10% discount you requested on invoice INV-2026-0142 (₹2,36,000.00). Please confirm and our team will update the invoice.

Regards,
Accounts Receivable
Nexren AI
